notes.title: Update Report – 11/07/2025
notes.notes:
Thanks to feedback from playtesters and content creators who tried the game, we’ve made several improvements based on what stood out. Here’s what this patch includes:


Added more slots to biomass burner
Reduced recipe waiting times
Added inventory and storage sorting
Increased wind turbine and solar panel durability
Airship now moves with WASD and locks player during flight
Improved item descriptions
Minor UI fixes
Enhanced airship autocollision
Added directional arrows to placement previews
Smelter now supports multiple items if recipe uses one ingredient
